note: Inseparable mixed row/stack region: a slanted top row (p1 top-right, p2 top-left, boxes overlapping in X via the diagonal divider) over a full-width bottom panel p3 whose slanted top edge overlaps both in Y. Every candidate cut clips some panel past maxStraddleRatio on both axes, so the tournament fallback decides: p1/p2 are a row pair (Y-overlap 0.91 of the shorter panel) so p1 reads before p2 (RTL); p3 is stacked below both. Source selection emits p1, p2, p3. Exercises the 3+ panel inseparable path where a non-transitive pairwise comparator could give input-order-dependent results.
